subject: The same District Officer's teak desk in the hot weather, at midday. Harsh white light striking through half-closed jalousie shutters and laying hard bars across the wood. The fringe of a punkah hangs across the top of the frame. The dark green leather blotter in the middle of the frame is bare. A wet cloth draped over a glass tumbler, fine dust settled on the teak, the brass oil lamp unlit. Everything bleached and still.
